bone.$description: Bone — Primary canvas, page background, section surfaces — warm off-white replaces pure white to give every page a printed, slightly weathered feel

ink.$description: Ink — High-contrast neutral action fill for primary buttons on light surfaces.

ash.$description: Ash — Secondary surface, input fills, subtle dividers, disabled states — one step darker than Bone, used to separate zones without introducing color

paper.$description: Paper — Card surfaces, elevated panels, reverse text on dark images — true white reserved for surface lift against the warm canvas

pure-black.$description: Pure Black — Link borders, input borders, maximum-contrast accents where Ink is too soft

smoke.$description: Smoke — Muted helper text, input border default state, low-emphasis dividers

fog.$description: Fog — Mid-tone panel surface for subdued dark UI layers and secondary containers. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

twk-lausanne.$description: Body, UI, captions, links, buttons, table cells, lists — the workhorse at 13–18px weight 300–400; weight 700 used sparingly for section heads; tracking near 0 at body sizes opens to 0.06–0.075em at 11–13px for micro-labels

molitor.$description: Display and hero headlines only — oversized (75–250px) with line-height 0.85, negative tracking at -0.02em at display sizes, positive tracking 0.021–0.037em at smaller sizes; the signature voice, used for 1–3 word emotional statements

garaje.$description: All-caps category labels, tags, and small display micro-copy — wide tracking 0.044–0.053em gives a stamped, industrial quality to product names, status labels, and nav items

arial.$description: Arial — detected in extracted data but not described by AI

gtstandard-m.$description: GTStandard-M — detected in extracted data but not described by AI
